app.title: Show HN: ChaosTree – A zero-dependency Java tree library (AVL,RBT,B-Tree,B+Tree)
app.author: chaos_vy
app.description: A lightweight Java library implementing common tree data structures such as AVL, Red‑Black, B‑Tree and B+Tree with zero external dependencies.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and run mvn test to ensure all unit tests pass.
Build a simple Java program that creates an AVL tree, inserts 10,000 integers, and measures insertion time.
Verify that the tree balances correctly by performing in‑order traversal and checking sorted order.
Benchmark lookup latency for 1,000 random keys and compare against Java's TreeMap.
